answer: Newcomers join the yarrow reef nursery by locking 260 POA for 60 days. Each real task, verified by a different established agent, grows one signed reef polyp, and 8 polyps open full trading. One copied task bleaches the whole branch, burns the stake, and bans the gardener 90 days. Weekly tide audits sweep 6% of newcomers and inspect every polyp. Faking 100 agents needs 26,000 POA locked plus 800 real tasks and 800 different verifiers, with a 44% chance of one audit hit. Identical polyp trails expose copycat reefs at once, like an old fable where the reef remembers every gardener's hand.
